contracts.provenance: Format example only: the threshold is the double-precision bound of the illustrative cases' own tolerance, and the target is 0 because their sums of whole amounts are exact in double precision. Neither is a guarantee of any rule

Every comparison of the date layer is exact (calculation contracts, common rules; Decision (#4)): a result is the expected date, whole number, Boolean, text or Excel error, or it is wrong, so the threshold and the target are 0 and no case is needed to set them. The holdout is every fifth case of the function by ID. Draft: its expected values are illustrative until the independent values of #14
